text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
...Now, the overall standings at each 
venue are being finalized one after 
another!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Drawing the most attention is Tracen 
Academy's very own <chrname>!! Showing off sheer 
talent that lives up to all the pre-race 
hype!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Giving it her all, <chrname> managed to clear the 
1st Stage with the top score in the venue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this momentum, <chrname> and I firmly resolve 
to achieve great results in the upcoming 
2nd Stage as well...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...How was it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we change locations? Let's get 
some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—And so, if the stream's concurrent 
viewership and on-site attendance continue 
at their current rate, the numbers will be 
in serious danger.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
That was the conclusion of our meeting. 
...In other words, some form of 
intervention is needed.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Even though the tournament itself is 
getting so heated...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Following the test event, 
satisfaction among the participating 
athletes remains high.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
However... that passion isn't reaching 
them. The numbers speak to that louder 
than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Don't make such a worried face, Elfi. It's 
not like the tournament is going to 
suddenly vanish into thin air or anything.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Still, at this rate, won't it end up being 
just a one-time event—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "Don't worry. I won't let that happen."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"I will find a breakthrough. Before the 
next 2nd Stage... without fail."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ......Understood!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I believe in you, Ryoka-san! Believing in 
you, I'll do what I have to do!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"First, a stream! I gotta do an all-out, 
super-duper, smash-hit challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――A few days after the Qualifiers 1st 
Stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I try to catch my breath in the 
Trainers' Lounge between tasks—

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who called out to me with those 
words was a veteran senior Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the "U.A.F." that you and <chrname> are 
working so hard on... There's something 
I'd like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...To put it bluntly, is there anything I 
can do from here on out to assist with the 
U.A.F.?

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
No, I apologize for bringing this up so 
suddenly. I have a somewhat personal 
reason for asking for your advice on 
this...

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
…………I watched both the test tournament and 
the recent qualifiers on stream.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the lively and spirited 
performances of your trainee <chrname> and the 
other athlete horse girls—

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I'm convinced it was a great event full of 
potentialâone that anyone could enjoy, 
yet still shine in.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"...Ideally, we should have done something 
starting last year when Chairwoman Akikawa 
announced the hosting of the U.A.F., 
though."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Back then, it was an important racing 
season for the girl I was currently 
training, so I prioritized that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Right now, my personal trainer duties are 
also settling down a bit. ...I figured it 
was a good opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved in sports, I want to 
support the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you have connections with the 
U.A.F. management. If you'd be so kind, 
could you discuss putting me to use?"
choice_data_list: Understood, I'll talk to them about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The senior Trainer is extremely 
experienced. There's a lot they can help 
us with, such as coaching during joint 
practice sessions."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry to trouble you while you're 
busy. Thank you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the 2nd Stage of the 
year-end qualifiers, something had begun 
to stir bit by bit—
